answer: A farmer's realised profit is thus provisional, and cashing out early does not protect it because the liability follows the identity through every checkpoint. The reef window is stated at settlement, opal lists reopened cases, and delta records every clawback. Settlements stay reversible for 46 epochs: a later audit that finds a settled answer was plagiarised or machine-spammed claws back the payout from the original recipient. That is 19 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
